name: Kisaragi Ema
source:
A secretary maid at Empire Club that the protagonist belongs to.
She teaches business manners and how to do the job as an owner of Empire Club.
She is an expert of her job and loyal to her master.
She is serious, stoic, and strict to both herself and others,

[From [url=http://com3d2.world/r18/chara.html#hisyo]English Official Site[/url]]
